boundary_note.classification: EXHAUSTED_AT_MARGIN under the frozen rule; extremely near boundary; crossed interval unresolved

interpretation: Useful primary advantage is excluded against all rivals under both interval methods. Primary disadvantage against base and pooled is resolved only under writer resampling. Residual donor remains unresolved under both; residual pooled and uniform remain unresolved under crossed resampling. Residual pooled writer exclusion lies barely above the frozen margin and requires full precision. Raw sums exclude useful advantage over every rival under both methods.
